description: Searches the table of construction estimating constants (densities, yields, coverage, unit weights), each row with its value, unit, SI value, condition and published source. Rows whose publisher does not allow republication return value null with values_withheld true: read the value at source_url. Returns at most 50 rows per call. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

category.description: Keep only the rows of one category.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against category, material_or_item and quantity.

name: search_constants
title: Search Estimating Constants
